### Knowledge maintenance jobs run in dependency cascade order — new jobs must slot before doc sync at 5:30 AM [VERIFIED]

Daily knowledge maintenance jobs run in dependency order: compound learning decay (3:45) → memory consolidation (4:00) → skill lifecycle (4:15) → shared knowledge import+quality recalc (4:30) → knowledge graph confidence decay+quality recalc (4:45) → doc sync (5:30). Each stage feeds the next: learnings decay first, then survivors import to shared knowledge, then graph nodes recompute, then everything syncs to docs. New maintenance jobs should be scheduled AFTER their data dependencies and BEFOR...

- **Importance**: 1.0 | **Confidence**: 1.0 | **Effectiveness**: -
- **Scope**: global | **Tags**: sidekiq, scheduling, maintenance, knowledge-lifecycle

### Dead maintenance methods pattern: wire model lifecycle methods to jobs and endpoints in the same PR [VERIFIED]

KnowledgeGraphNode#decay_confidence! and #recalculate_quality_score! existed since initial implementation but were never called by any job or endpoint. SharedKnowledgeService#recalculate_all_quality was similarly orphaned. Pattern: when adding model methods for lifecycle management, always wire them into a scheduled job AND an API endpoint in the same PR. Check for orphaned methods by grepping for the method name across jobs/ and controllers/.
